name: Predicting properties and interactions
gist: Helping researchers quickly predict what a molecule or drug will do—its toxicity, activity, or how it binds to proteins—without expensive experiments.
explain: When a drug company tests a new candidate molecule, they ask dozens of questions: Is it toxic? Does it stick to the target protein? Does it get absorbed in the gut? Does it cross the blood-brain barrier? Each test takes time and money — sometimes months and hundreds of thousands of dollars per molecule. Most candidates fail, so you want to kill the losers early.

The bottleneck is that chemists must choose which candidates to test first, usually based on intuition or pattern recognition from past failures. What if we could predict those properties directly from the molecular structure? A machine learning model trained on past test results could screen thousands of candidates computationally and flag the winners for expensive lab testing. This would save time, money, and animals, and accelerate drug discovery.

The papers in this cluster predict molecular properties from structure: predicting how toxic a drug is, how strong it binds to a protein target, whether it will be absorbed in the body, how it will be metabolized. The challenge is that molecules are complex 3D objects, and what matters is not just what atoms they contain but how those atoms are arranged and bonded. A naive model might ignore the 3D structure and fail on molecules that look similar on paper but fold very differently. Some papers use graph neural networks — a way to represent molecules as connected nodes — so the model understands bonds and structure the way chemistry does, which means it can generalize to new molecules it has never seen because it learned the rules of bonding rather than memorizing specific structures. Others use 3D coordinates directly to predict binding strength. Still others combine multiple models to predict a whole profile of properties at once, which is more reliable than predicting each property separately because errors in one property can lead to errors in another, so joint prediction catches those mistakes.

papers.title: A Function-Centric Graph Neural Network Approach for Predicting Electron Densities
papers.contribution: Surpasses previous state-of-the-art on QM9 and MD density datasets with excellent generalization to larger molecules up to 200 atoms.

papers.title: Adaptive Data-Knowledge Alignment in Genetic Perturbation Prediction
papers.contribution: ALIGNED outperforms state-of-the-art by achieving highest balanced consistency while re-discovering biologically meaningful knowledge for transcriptional response prediction.

papers.title: Efficient Prediction of Large Protein Complexes via Subunit-Guided Hierarchical Refinement
papers.contribution: Matches AlphaFold3 accuracy while raising success rates from 49.9% to 73.1% on recent PDB set, cuts peak memory by ~25GB (~40%), and successfully models complexes over 5,000 tokens.

papers.title: Enhancing Molecular Property Predictions by Learning from Bond Modelling and Interactions
papers.contribution: Establishes state-of-the-art on PCQM4Mv2, OC20 IS2RE, QM9, and MoleculeNet benchmarks through explicit bond-information modeling and intricate atom-bond interaction learning.

papers.title: Fast Proteome-Scale Protein Interaction Retrieval via Residue-Level Factorization
papers.contribution: RaftPPI retrieves top 20% proteome candidates covering 75.1% true interactions in 6 GPU minutes (vs 4.9 months), achieving state-of-the-art PPI classification across seven benchmarks.

papers.title: I2Mole: Interaction-aware Invariant Molecular Learning For Generalizable Property Prediction
papers.contribution: I2Mole accurately captures core substructures and significantly enhances model generalization for predicting drug-drug interaction properties.

papers.title: Learning from the Electronic Structure of Molecules across the Periodic Table
papers.contribution: State-of-the-art Hamiltonian prediction scaling to 100+ atoms with 58 elements, plus a curated 58k-molecule dataset demonstrating electronic interactions as a transferable data source.

papers.title: Rapid Training of Hamiltonian Graph Networks Using Random Features
papers.contribution: Trains 150-600x faster with comparable accuracy across diverse simulations including systems with up to 10,000 particles, with zero-shot generalization to 4096-node systems.

papers.title: $\texttt{FlashSchNet}$: Fast and Accurate Coarse-Grained Neural Network Molecular Dynamics
papers.contribution: Achieves 1000 ns/day aggregate simulation throughput over 64 parallel replicas on coarse-grained protein containing 269 beads, a 6.5x improvement.

papers.title: A Cartesian-3j Framework for Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
papers.contribution: Cartesian counterparts of MACE, NequIP, and Allegro achieve comparable accuracy to spherical models; TACE-v1-OAM-M demonstrates competitive performance on Matbench Discovery.

papers.title: BLIPs: Bayesian Learned Interatomic Potentials
papers.contribution: BLIPs improves predictive accuracy over standard MLIPs with trustworthy uncertainty estimates, especially in data-scarce and heavy out-of-distribution regimes, with consistent gains from fine-tuning pretrained MLIPs.

papers.title: Beyond Structure: Invariant Crystal Property Prediction with Pseudo-Particle Ray Diffraction
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance on Materials Project, JARVIS-DFT, and MatBench benchmarks for crystal property prediction.

papers.title: CellBRIDGE: Learning Cellular Trajectories via Interaction-Aware Alignment
papers.contribution: Improve cross-snapshot couplings and trajectory estimates on synthetic and real scRNA-seq data, and enable mechanistically interpretable in silico perturbations.

papers.title: Contrastive Geometric Learning Unlocks Unified Structure- and Ligand-Based Drug Design
papers.contribution: Achieves competitive zero-shot virtual screening and state-of-the-art ligand-conditioned pocket selection.

papers.title: DeCoDe: Decoupling Binding Position and Molecular Conformation in 3D Ligand Diffusion for Structure-Based Drug Design
papers.contribution: Achieves 18% average improvement in structural fidelity on CrossDocked2020 benchmark while maintaining competitive binding affinity and molecular properties.

papers.title: DeepSADR: Deep Transfer Learning with Subsequence Interaction and Adaptive Readout for Cancer Drug Response Prediction
papers.contribution: Significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods on clinical patient cohorts for drug response prediction.

papers.title: DistMLIP: A Distributed Inference Platform for Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
papers.contribution: Demonstrates near-million-atom calculations on 8 GPUs within seconds on four state-of-the-art MLIPs (CHGNet, MACE, TensorNet, eSEN).

papers.title: EEG-Based Multimodal Learning via Hyperbolic Mixture-of-Curvature Experts
papers.contribution: Electroencephalography (EEG)-based multimodal learning integrates brain signals with complementary modalities to improve mental state assessment, providing great clinical potential

papers.title: Enhancing Protein-Protein Interaction Prediction with Hierarchical Motif-based Multimodal Protein Embedding
papers.contribution: Outperforms state-of-the-art multi-label PPI models, particularly under challenging data partitions and limited data scenarios.

papers.title: EvoEGF-Mol: Evolving Exponential Geodesic Flow for Structure-based Drug Design
papers.contribution: Approaches reference PoseBusters passing rate of 93.4% on CrossDock with geometric precision, achieving superior performance on real-world MolGenBench tasks.

papers.title: Flexible Kernels for Protein Property Prediction
papers.contribution: Data-efficient Gaussian process models frequently outperform alternatives relying on foundation model embeddings, and structure-conditioned kernels excel at multi-task learning across multiple protein property landscapes.

papers.title: FlowSymm: Physics–Aware, Symmetry–Preserving Graph Attention for Network Flow Completion
papers.contribution: FlowSymm substantially outperforms baselines across traffic, power, and bike-sharing networks in RMSE, MAE, and correlation metrics.

papers.title: From Holo Pockets to Electron Density: GPT-style Drug Design with Density
papers.contribution: The method produces molecules with 3D conformations and demonstrates effectiveness on 101 biological targets.

papers.title: Geometric Graph Neural Diffusion for Stable Molecular Dynamics
papers.contribution: Outperforms baseline models in both accuracy and stability under significant topological shifts on 3BPA and SAMD23 benchmarks, advancing stable molecular modeling.

papers.title: HEIST: A Graph Foundation Model for Spatial Transcriptomics and Proteomics Data
papers.contribution: HEIST achieves strong performance with generalizability to datasets with different genes than pretraining through dynamic gene embeddings.

papers.title: KGOT: Unified Knowledge Graph and Optimal Transport Pseudo-Labeling for Molecule-Protein Interaction Prediction
papers.contribution: Substantial improvements over state-of-the-art in prediction accuracy and zero-shot ability; demonstrates new paradigm for leveraging heterogeneous biological data.

papers.title: Latent Diffusion Pretraining for Crystal Property Prediction
papers.contribution: Improves performance by 4.26% on JARVIS and 4.90% on MP datasets; remains robust in sparse-data conditions and corrects DFT errors with limited experimental data.

papers.title: Learning the Interaction Prior for Protein-Protein Interaction Prediction: A Model-Agnostic Approach
papers.contribution: Achieves superior performance enhancements over competitors as a lightweight plug-and-play module, injecting interaction prior of complementarity.

papers.title: LipoPU: Pocket-level Prediction of Lipid-Protein Interactions via Positive-Unlabeled Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves consistent gains over supervised baselines and identifies biologically informative residues via structural case studies.

papers.title: MOES-Pred: Molecular Structural Representation Learning by Adaptive Energy-Sentinel Vibration for Generalized Property Prediction
papers.contribution: Surpasses mainstream approaches in force prediction and downstream quantum chemical property prediction with substantial improvements through molecule-specific noising strategies.

papers.title: MatRIS: Toward Reliable and Efficient Pretrained Machine Learning Interaction Potentials
papers.contribution: Matches equivariant model accuracy on Matbench-Discovery (F1=0.847) while improving training efficiency by 13.0-13.5× at comparable accuracy.

papers.title: Mesh Based Simulations with Spatial and Temporal awareness
papers.contribution: The framework shows consistent improvements in accuracy and stability across multiple architectures and datasets, particularly for long-horizon rollouts.

papers.title: MoMa: A Simple Modular Learning Framework for Material Property Prediction
papers.contribution: Achieves 14% average improvement over strongest baseline across 17 datasets with strong performance in few-shot and scaling experiments.

papers.title: Neural Minimum Weight Perfect Matching for Quantum Error Codes
papers.contribution: NMWPM achieves quantum error correction thresholds of 17.9% and 10.95%, nearing the theoretical maximum likelihood bounds of 18.9% and 11.0%.

papers.title: PFT: Phonon Fine-tuning for Machine Learned Interatomic Potentials
papers.contribution: Improves phonon properties by 55% on average on the MDR Phonon benchmark and generalizes to improve third-order derivative properties.

papers.title: PerturbDiff: Functional Diffusion for Single-Cell Perturbation Modeling
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance in single-cell response prediction with substantially better generalization to unseen perturbations.

papers.title: PhenoBrain: Phenotype-Conditioned Long-Range Communication for Multi-Modal Brain Network Analysis
papers.contribution: PhenoBrain achieves state-of-the-art performance on multi-modal brain network analysis datasets with phenotype-conditioned architecture.

papers.title: ReCoG: Relational and Compact Context Graph Learning for Few-shot Molecular Property Prediction
papers.contribution: Demonstrates the importance of joint relational and compact knowledge extraction in context graphs through theoretical analysis.

papers.title: Reading the Cell, Designing the Cure: Perturbation-Conditioned Molecular Diffusion for Function-Oriented Drug Design
papers.contribution: Outperforms baselines in structural quality and functional consistency, with validated utility via zero-shot gene-inhibitor design.

papers.title: What Makes a Representation Good for Single-Cell Perturbation Prediction?
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance with significant gains in out-of-distribution combinatorial predictions and interpretable perturbation-response programs.

papers.title: h-MINT: Modeling Pocket-Ligand Binding with Hierarchical Molecular Interaction Network
papers.contribution: Improves binding affinity prediction by 2-4% Pearson/Spearman correlation, enhances virtual screening by 1-3% on multiple benchmarks.
